overview: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon model emphasizes cybersecurity and long‑horizon tasks, entering a staged rollout for trusted partners.
Legal AI platform Legora leverages OpenAI agents to accelerate contract review and internal debugging, highlighting agentic workflow gains.
Microsoft disclosed Azure revenue of $33.2 billion, confirming its lead over Google Cloud and underscoring cloud‑AI growth.

top.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
top.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model topping security benchmarks (SEC‑bench Pro, ExploitGym) and offering improved coding, agentic, and scientific performance, with a phased release to cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program.

top.title: Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work
top.summary: Legora, powered by OpenAI models and coding agents, provides an agentic operating system for legal work, speeding contract review and internal issue resolution, and enabling rapid prototyping of solutions.

top.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
top.summary: Microsoft reported Azure generated $33.2 billion in Q3 revenue, a 48% YoY increase, surpassing Google Cloud and exceeding analyst expectations, highlighting Azure’s central role in AI infrastructure.

top.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity
top.summary: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon claims top rankings on AI benchmarks, especially in cybersecurity, and is initially available to select defense firms before broader partner rollout.

top.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
top.summary: Ars Technica notes Gemini 4 Carbon as an incremental upgrade over Argon, with modest benchmark gains and a cautious, staged release due to safety considerations.

top.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
top.summary: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership, integrating OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow workflows for development, IT, and security, adding ChatGPT Work and Codex capabilities for enterprise users.
